title: Shipping an Enterprise Voice AI Agent in 100 Days - Peter Bar, Intercom Fin
talk_summary: Intercom built Fin Voice, a phone support agent, in about 100 days using STT-LLM-TTS plus RAG and telephony. The talk emphasizes use-case selection, MVP tooling, voice-specific conversation design, workflow integration, regression evals, observability, and outcome metrics.

takeaways.what_they_do: They maintain a set of test conversations and run them on every major code change; it started as a manual spreadsheet and was later automated.
They built internal Streamlit apps to review logs, transcripts, and recordings when customers raise issues.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we built some internal the Streamlit web apps to review the logs that the transcripts the the recordings

takeaways.what_they_do: They define resolution as user confirmation on the call or disconnect after at least one answer with no callback within 24 hours, and track it as the main success metric.
takeaways.evidence_quote: either the user confirming on the call that the issue was resolved or the user disconnects after hearing at least one answer
takeaways.numbers: 56% average resolution rate; 70-80% for some customers (Fin chat, not voice-specific)

takeaways.what_they_do: After every AI call they generate a transcript summary so the human agent receiving the escalation has context on what happened.
takeaways.evidence_quote: after every AI agent call, we generate a transcript summary that gives a bit more context to the human agent

takeaways.what_they_do: They configured how calls escalate to the human support team, because workflow integration was a bigger blocker than model or latency.
takeaways.evidence_quote: getting configurations for how the calls get escalated to the human support team

takeaways.what_they_do: They experimentally use another LLM to analyze call transcripts to identify issues and improvement opportunities.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we're using another LLM to analyze the call transcripts to help us identify issues or opportunities for improvement
